Sayed al-Hashim Mosque

📍 Gaza City, gaza-city
Historic Mosque gaza-city 1850 destroyed

Important pilgrimage site containing tomb believed to be that of Hashim ibn Abd Manaf grandfather of Prophet Muhammad. Named UNESCO tentative World Heritage site. Significant religious and historical importance. Repeatedly targeted in November and December 2023. Extensive damage to structure and tomb area.
